data: Which task(s) show a consistently decreasing trend in performance as the length of input sequence increases?

Let me analyze each graph:

Graph (a): Link prediction - The AUC values for all datasets increase slightly but then level off after about 10-15 units of length. There is no consistent decrease.

Graph (b): Similarity search - The AUC values for all datasets increase steadily until around 20 units of length, then level off. Again, there is no consistent decrease.

Graph (c): Node classification - The F1 scores for all datasets increase steadily until around 20 units of length, then level off. No consistent decrease.

Graph (d): Node clustering - The NMI values for all datasets increase steadily until around 20 units of length, then level off. No consistent decrease.

Looking at all four graphs, none of them show a consistently decreasing trend as the length of input sequence increases. All show either an initial increase followed by leveling off or a steady increase without any clear decrease.
